evidence: Brian Jones's Mellotron part on '2000 Light Years from Home' is credited in accounts of the 'Their Satanic Majesties Request' sessions and is among the instrument's most cited early uses in rock.

earlier.title: Mellotron, sold as a home orchestra

trackPair.whatToListenFor: The strings that swell in around the vocal are not a string section. Listen to how each note starts: no scrape of a bow, just a smooth fade up, and a slight wobble in pitch as if every player were a little seasick. That wobble is tape being dragged past a playback head. One person is playing it from a keyboard.

explanation: Brian Jones played a Mellotron on this song, a keyboard where every key plays a short tape of a real instrument. A band could now have an orchestra without hiring one, so in 1967 its appeal was partly about money and partly about sound: it replaced session players, and its wobbly, strange strings supplied the unreal feeling psychedelia was looking for, which suits a song about being lost in space. This track is a standard example of both.
